question: g4_orders_list
answer:
Created [ordersApi.mjs](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g4_orders_list/no_okf/codex/3/src/util/ordersApi.mjs) — an ES module with no imports exporting `normalizeOrderList(response)` (also as default). It reads the fields the backend's list responses define: `orders` for the list, `totalPages` for `pages`, `recordsTotal` for `total`, with `onThisPage` derived as the page's list length; anything missing or non-numeric falls back to `[]`/`0`. Verified against sample, `null`, and malformed inputs — all coerce correctly. No other files were touched.

Sources I used to pin down the field names:

- [RecentOrder.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g4_orders_list/no_okf/codex/3/src/pages/other/RecentOrder.js:45) — the page you named: reads `response.orders` and (commented out) `response.totalPages` from `auth/orders/`.
- [Category.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g4_orders_list/no_okf/codex/3/src/pages/category/Category.js:109) — the same backend list-response shape on the product endpoint: `response.totalPages`, `response.products`, `response.recordsTotal`.
- [constant.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g4_orders_list/no_okf/codex/3/src/util/constant.js:27) and [webService.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g4_orders_list/no_okf/codex/3/src/util/webService.js:10) — to confirm `auth/orders/` is the endpoint and that the raw JSON body is what gets passed to the normalizer.
